what: devcontainer features test cannot run in parallel as is: its work dir is named by Date.now() (EEXIST on same-ms starts) and its end-of-run cleanup removes every container labelled devcontainer.is_test_run, including sibling runs. Also flat taskfile includes share vars, so the existing IMAGE var of feature.taskfile.yml shadowed the new required IMAGE.
tell: parallel runs fail with 'EEXIST ... .devcontainer/ocx' or 'container ... is not running'; test:image reported IMAGE has an invalid value 'ocx-feature-unit'
proposed_change: research doc section 6h: note --preserve-test-containers plus own cleanup for parallel runs; note flat-include var collisions
